title: iPHAsimulator
description:
iPHAsimulator is a notebook-driven Python toolkit for building, validating, parameterising, simulating, preprocessing and analysing polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) oligomer systems. It generates chemically defined PHA oligomers, prepares Amber/GAFF2, GROMACS and OpenMM simulation inputs, supports HPC execution, and provides trajectory analysis and enzyme–PHA contact workflows.

Developed at King's College London within the EU EIC Pathfinder project SATISPHACTION (https://satisphaction.eu/).

Documentation: https://mmlabcodes.github.io/iPHAsimulator/
